component.name: AivinNet
component.summary: Music server for your files running on Python {{ python-fullversion }}

description.p: AivinNet is a fast, self-hosted music server for your local audio files — a web player with a look of its own, streaming your own library. Start the app and open it in a web browser. Originally forked from Swing Music (https://swingmx.com/), AGPL-3.0.
